title: Smooth homotopy identity at the level of values, via the cylinder boundary relation
statement: Notation: ℝ^m = Euclid m; 𝒟_k(ℝ^m) = GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid m)) k; 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) = TestFormOn univ k; |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α; M(T) = T.mass = T.massOn univ, M_W(T) = T.massOn W; spt = support; ∂ = boundary, ∂T(ω) = T(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply; dω = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k ω, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative ω); ι(t,x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; Jv = ι(0,v); S(X) = {ι(t,x) : t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X}; F^#ω(x) = (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x); X is NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for degree ≥ 1, = 0 in degree 0). Assume (VO) for all P, n, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0 and (REP) for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n with μ(Uᶜ) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), and (if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U) μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0. Let N, N' ∈ ℕ and F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} be C^∞ with H(ι(t,x)) = F(x) + t•(G(x) − F(x)) for all t, x. (Degree 0) Let X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) have compact support, C ∈ 𝒟_{0+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with spt C ⊆ S(X), and suppose that for every β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}) there are η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with η_s(x)(v) = β(ι(s,x))(J∘v) (s = 0, 1) and ∂C(β) = X(η₁) − X(η₀). If ω ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N'}), ηF, ηG ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) equal F^#ω, G^#ω on open sets containing spt X, and θ ∈ 𝒟^{0+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) equals (dω(H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (DH(y)) on an open set containing S(X), then X(ηG) − X(ηF) = C(θ). (Degree k+1) Let X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) have compact support, C ∈ 𝒟_{k+1+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and C' ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with spt C, spt C' ⊆ S(X), and suppose that for every β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there are η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η_s(x)(v) = β(ι(s,x))(J∘v) and ∂C(β) = X(η₁) − X(η₀) − C'(β). If ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}), ηF, ηG are as before, θ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) equals H^#(dω) and θ' ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) equals H^#ω on open sets containing S(X), then X(ηG) − X(ηF) = C(θ) + C'(θ').

F x)) → (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (0 + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) 0) (ηF ηG : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (0 + 1)), IsCompact X.support → C.support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} → (∀ β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0, ∃ η₀ η₁ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0, (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), (η₀ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ C.boundary β = X η₁ - X η₀) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηF : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') 0) (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηG : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) 0) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') 0) (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid (N + 1)), IsOpen W ∧ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} ⊆ W ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (0 + 1)) y = (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') 0) (H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ H y)) → X ηG - X ηF = C θ) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1 + 1)) (C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) (k + 1)) (ηF ηG : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1 + 1)) (θ' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)), IsCompact X.support → C.support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} → C'.support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} → (∀ β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), ∃ η₀ η₁ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1), (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), (η₀ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ C.boundary β = X η₁ - X η₀ - C' β) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηF : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηG : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid (N + 1)), IsOpen W ∧ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} ⊆ W ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1 + 1)) y = (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ H y)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid (N + 1)), IsOpen W ∧ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))} ⊆ W ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, (θ' : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) y = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ H y)) → X ηG -
